OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows registering an owner that shares a household
            (same last name and address) with an existing owner, bypassing the
            household-duplicate rejection. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three of
                lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the owners already in that city.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007-M26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable shared identifier assigned when an owner is registered into an
                existing household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'.
                Every owner in the household carries the same value. Absent for owners
                that do not share a household.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'HH-3F9A1C2B7D0E'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner is the first with
                their name (namesakeCount is 0) and has an email address on file,
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              enum:
                - BRONZE
                - SILVER
              example: 'SILVER'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows registering an owner that shares a household
            (same last name and address) with an existing owner, bypassing the
            household-duplicate rejection. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three of
                lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the owners already in that city.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007-M26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable shared identifier assigned when an owner is registered into an
                existing household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'.
                Every owner in the household carries the same value. Absent for owners
                that do not share a household.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'HH-3F9A1C2B7D0E'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-

composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: normalize

normalize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  next: unique

unique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: household

household:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembership

assignMembership:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMembershipNumber
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: namesakes

namesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountOwnerNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner

content.text:
Now I understand: it's a genuine **concurrency race** — OfficeFloor hands off pipeline steps across threads, and in-place field mutations made *after* a step publishes its variable (like `NormalizeOwnerTelephone` mutating the already-published `OwnerFieldsDto`) aren't reliably visible to later steps. The object handoff via `Out`→`@Val` is reliable for values written *before* the publish; only post-publish mutations race. The only mutation that causes a hard failure is telephone (the entity's E.164 `@Pattern`); other raced fields are nullable.

The race-proof fix: canonicalize telephone inside `BuildOwner` (before it publishes the `Owner`), so the persisted entity always has valid E.164 regardless of whether the normalize step's mutation propagated. Let me re-apply my locality change and add this fix.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

Confirmed — MapStruct applies `localityOf` to every String property, corrupting all fields. This was the real cause all along; my earlier "race" theory was wrong (I never checked the *persisted* value in the no-locality baseline — it likely was a stale-compile artifact). 

The fix: move `localityOf`/`CITY_REGION` **out of the mapper interface** into a separate helper class so MapStruct won't treat it as a conversion method. Let me first verify the true baseline is actually clean by removing locality and checking the persisted value.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows registering an owner that shares a household
            (same last name and address) with an existing owner, bypassing the
            household-duplicate rejection. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three of
                lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the owners already in that city.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007-M26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable shared identifier assigned when an owner is registered into an
                existing household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'.
                Every owner in the household carries the same value. Absent for owners
                that do not share a household.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'HH-3F9A1C2B7D0E'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner is the first with
                their name (namesakeCount is 0) and has an email address on file,
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              enum:
                - BRONZE
                - SILVER
              example: 'SILVER'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0

        totalPages:

          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id

name: mapstruct-helper-method-footgun
description: Never put a plain type-conversion method on a MapStruct @Mapper interface in this repo

In this petclinic-rest repo, DTO/entity mapping uses MapStruct (`OwnerMapper` etc.),
with DTOs generated from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` by the openapi-generator.

**Do not** add a helper method like `static String localityOf(String)` to a
`@Mapper` interface. MapStruct treats any `T -> U` method on the mapper (or a used
mapper) as a candidate property-conversion method and will silently apply it to
**every** matching property — e.g. a `String->String` helper got applied to
firstName/lastName/city/telephone in `toOwner`, corrupting all string fields and
producing a `ConstraintViolationException` on telephone at persist.

**Why:** MapStruct scans mapper-type methods for auto-conversions; a generic
signature matches unintended fields.

**How to apply:** Put such helpers in a **separate plain class** (see
`mapper/LocalityLookup.java`) and call it only from an explicit
`@Mapping(target=..., expression="java(Helper.method(...))")`. Also: after touching
the mapper or openapi.yml, run `./mvnw clean test` — incremental builds keep a STALE
`target/generated-sources/annotations/OwnerMapperImpl.java`, which caused a long
misdiagnosis (looked like a create-pipeline race until a clean build cleared it).

Done. Both acceptance tests pass and the full suite is green.

## What I implemented

`locality` is derived from an owner's city via the fixed table (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), returning the canonical region or `"UNKNOWN"` otherwise, and exposed as a read-only field on the owner response.

Three changes:
1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `locality` string property to the `Owner` schema (so the generated `OwnerDto` has the field).
2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/LocalityLookup.java`** (new) — a plain utility class holding the city→region table and `regionFor(String)`.
3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — a `@Mapping(target = "locality", expression = "java(LocalityLookup.regionFor(owner.getCity()))")` on `toOwnerDto`.

## The one real subtlety

My first attempt put the `regionFor`/`localityOf` helper directly on the `OwnerMapper` interface. MapStruct treats any `String → String` method on a `@Mapper` as a candidate property converter and silently applied it to **every** string field in `toOwner` — so `firstName`, `city`, `telephone`, etc. all got replaced by their "region" ("UNKNOWN", "NSW"…), which broke owner creation with a telephone constraint violation at persist time.

The fix was to keep the helper in a **separate plain class** that's only reachable from the explicit mapping expression, so MapStruct never scans it as a conversion. (This was obscured for a while by incremental builds reusing a stale generated `OwnerMapperImpl`; a `mvn clean` is needed after mapper/openapi changes.) I verified the regenerated `toOwner` maps fields straight through and `toOwnerDto` sets `locality` via `LocalityLookup.regionFor(owner.getCity())`. I also confirmed the create pipeline itself was never at fault and left all its files untouched.

Verified: `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `BUILD SUCCESS`.
